scope: Dev-fitted, versioned multiclass temperature calibration with independent test evaluation
validated_behaviors: Temperature is fitted only from a complete dev probability set.
An independent complete test run evaluates the frozen mapping.
Dev and test runs must share the exact model and configuration identity.
The content-addressed calibration version excludes all test inputs.
Test Brier, ECE and fixed reliability bins are reported before admission.
Admission requires publishable private gold, at least 200 dev and 200 test cases, non-regression and test ECE at most 0.10.
known_boundary: This creates and evaluates a mapping contract only. It does not run a model, enable calibrated confidence, change a publication pointer or deploy production.
